name: Rome
summary: Anchor the visit around the Colosseum and Vatican, then leave time for the historic centre on foot. Paid monuments and spontaneous neighbourhood meals work better on separate blocks than a rushed checklist.
seasonNote: Summer heat and queues are intense; Easter and major events affect access.
arrival: Use the airport train or an official taxi route into Rome; choose lodging with a practical station or metro link.
gettingAround: Walk central clusters; use metro for cross-city trips and check bus routes in a current map.
cashTip: Cards are widely accepted; keep EUR cash for small purchases and check any restaurant cover charge.
foodTip: Try cacio e pepe, supplì and pizza al taglio; check whether pizza is priced by weight.
buyTip: Buy food gifts or artisan goods rather than souvenir bundles near the busiest monuments.

connections.note: Typical fastest rail journey; reserve a specific train and check the timetable.
